topics.topic: Three Primary Gut Regions & Embryological Origin
topics.mindmap_node: Insect Digestive System > Three Primary Regions
key_facts: Tripartite division: Foregut (Stomodaeum), Midgut (Mesenteron), Hindgut (Proctodaeum).
Embryology: Foregut and Hindgut are ectodermal; Midgut is endodermal.
Cuticular intima shed at each moult in foregut and hindgut; midgut has naked microvilli.
Boundary landmarks: Cardiac (stomodaeal) valve anteriorly; Pyloric valve and Malpighian tubules posteriorly.
Five layers from lumen outward: Cuticular Intima (fore/hindgut only), Single-layer Epithelium, Basement Membrane, Circular Muscle Layer, Longitudinal Muscle Layer.
Peritoneal membrane encloses the tube externally with trachea and nerves.
Cibarium and pharynx form the cibarial sucking pump for fluid uptake.
Crop is an expandable, thin-walled food storage and pre-digestion chamber.
Proventriculus (Gizzard) in chewing insects has 6 sclerotised chitinous teeth/denticles for crushing food.
Proventriculus in honeybees has 4 triangular mobile lip-valves that strain pollen from nectar.
Salivary glands secrete amylase and invertase; blood-feeders secrete apyrase and nitrophorins.

topics.topic: Midgut Cytology, Goblet Cell Physiology & Bt Action
key_facts: Ventriculus and gastric caeca multiply absorptive and enzyme-secreting surface area.
Three cell types: Columnar enterocytes (absorption), Regenerative stem cells/nidi (renewal), Goblet cells (ion transport).
Goblet cell V-type H+/K+ ATPase pumps K+ to generate luminal pH 9-11, dissolving leaf tannins.
Bt Cry protoxins dissolve at pH 11, are cleaved by proteases, bind cadherin/APN, forming lytic pores that rupture enterocytes.

topics.mindmap_node: Insect Digestive System > Midgut > Peritrophic Membrane
key_facts: Chitin-glycoprotein semi-permeable matrix.
Type I delaminated from entire midgut epithelium; Type II secreted by anterior cardia organ.
Functions: Mechanical microvilli protection, pathogen barrier, and endo/ectoperitrophic enzyme compartmentalization.

topics.mindmap_node: Insect Digestive System > Hindgut & Excretory Integration
key_facts: Subdivisions: Pylorus, Ileum, Colon, Rectum.
Malpighian tubules filter hemolymph into potassium urate primary urine.
Cryptonephridial complex binds tubule ends to rectum in perinephric membrane to extract water in xeric pests.
6 longitudinal rectal pads/papillae with dense mitochondria and lateral canaliculi reabsorb 90% water to produce dry frass.
Uric acid precipitates as insoluble, non-toxic crystals with zero water loss.

topics.topic: Specialized Adaptations: Sap Filter Chamber & Termite Paunch
topics.mindmap_node: Insect Digestive System > Specialized Physiological Adaptations
key_facts: Homopteran sap filter chamber wraps anterior midgut around posterior midgut/hindgut to shunt excess water by osmosis directly to honeydew, avoiding enzyme dilution.
Termite hindgut paunch harbors symbiotic Trichonympha flagellates that produce cellulase to ferment wood into acetate.
Proctodaeal trophallaxis re-inoculates nymphs with symbionts after cuticular ecdysis.
